The image is a rectangular magazine cover with a red, textured background resembling a brick wall. Overlaid on the background are several vertical grey and black bars, creating the appearance of a jail cell.

In the lower foreground, a line-drawing of a man with black hair and a white collarless jacket stands behind the bars. He is looking forward, and his hands are shown gripping two of the vertical bars. To his left, the words "Gatot Pujo Nugroho" are printed in black. 

In the background, behind the man and the bars, is a large, dark-red silhouette of a bearded man's face with closed eyes. 

At the top, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large white capital letters. Above it is smaller text: "INVESTIGASI: SELINGKUH DOKTER-PABRIK OBAT" in yellow and white. Below "TEMPO" is the date "2-8 NOVEMBER 2015." To the left, large yellow text reads "KETIKA PALOH DITUDING." 

In the bottom right corner, there is a price of "RP 39.500," some small text, a barcode, and numbers.
